title: GOV-0040: badf-architecture has no ASSURE substrate — controls 13-18 unenforced (WP-ARCH-C; IMPLEMENTED -> VALIDATED)
problem:
## Observed
`badf-architecture` is `IMPLEMENTED` (G04 DESIGN semantics, WP-ARCH-B) but the **ASSURE** substrate — the read-only side of the frozen contract that checks whether reality conforms to declared architecture — does not exist. Controls 13–18 of the frozen contract are unenforced: there is no `assure` gate command, no architecture-assurance record schema, so nothing stops an assurance run from claiming COMPLIANT with no baseline, serialising an INDETERMINATE ADR result as a pass, self-authorising drift as approved, or omitting its non-coverage.

## Expected
Build WP-ARCH-C: a deterministic `assure` gate command and an `architecture-assurance` record schema enforcing controls 13–18 (per ARCH-I11, the analysis is the skill's; the gate validates the record):
- **13** an ASSURE run binds one baseline revision and one observed revision (ARCH-I09).
- **14** a `COMPLIANT` conclusion requires a bound baseline digest — `NO BASELINE ≠ COMPLIANT` (ARCH-I07).
- **15** an `INDETERMINATE` ADR-compliance result cannot serialise as a `COMPLIANT` pass.
- **16** a drift finding cannot classify itself as approved evolution — only independent authority may (ARCH-I08).
- **17** an ASSURE run declares its non-coverage.
- **18** every finding is assessed against the single bound baseline (ARCH-I01).
Read-only; `implementation_authority` is schema-fixed `false` (ARCH-I12). Ship an example validated in CI. This meets the `VALIDATED` criterion, so advance `badf-architecture` `IMPLEMENTED → VALIDATED`.

## Evidence
- `ls scripts/*architecture*` → none (ARCH-I11 preserved: the ASSURE validator is in the canonical gate, not a second script)
- no `schemas/architecture-assurance.schema.json`; no `assure` subcommand

## Unknowns
The structural analysis itself (dependency graph, cycles) is the skill's read-only work, not the gate's (the gate is deterministic and makes no network/exec call); it enforces the assurance record's integrity. `SHADOWED`/`APPROVED`/`ACTIVE` remain the operator's admission decisions.

## Proposed work package
`BADF-WP-0057` (WP-ARCH-C). `schemas/architecture-assurance.schema.json`; `validate_architecture_assurance` + the `assure` subcommand; controls 13–18; `examples/architecture-assurance.json` + CI; tests + mutation; own G07 self-dossier; advance `badf-architecture` to `VALIDATED`. C2.
